assignment: signal_eligible only; descending score, ascending PERMNO tie break; group=10-floor(10*zero_based_position/n); group 10 contains ceil(n/10)
label: frozen strict-main y_excess_5d; missing stays missing
boundary: assign all dates first; exclude whole dates with horizon beyond 2021-12-31 from return summaries, report their coverage separately
aggregation: within-date equal-weight mean of observed labels in the preassigned group; then equal date mean; report conditional-on-observation and coverage explicitly
proxy_sensitivity: fixed groups; fill only missing primary labels with existing frozen-proceeds proxy on non-boundary dates; unresolved remain missing

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks of daily IC differences vs momentum20
